title: Remote viewing Empress Himiko's palaces, temple and burial mountain

plain: A remote viewer named Joe McMoneagle says his team located the summer palace, winter palace, temple, mother's temple and burial mountain of Himiko, an ancient empress of Japan. Remote viewing is the claimed ability to describe distant places or times with the mind alone. McMoneagle tells Michels he did this himself with a group called the Noai group, and points to records of the royal court of China as showing that Himiko "existed".
